method.routeGraph: Historical OSRM route segments from 9631171:data/places/warmenhuizen/house-coverage.json, plus only the explicitly listed sensitivity bridges.
method.graphCoreWalkingDistanceM: Shortest path from the historical household route snap to the selected location graph node.
method.doorToRouteSnapLowerBoundM: Haversine distance from BAG point to the historical household route snap; not a proven walkable access route.
method.reportedWalkingDistanceM: Graph-core distance plus the straight BAG-to-route-snap lower bound used for map coloring.
method.locationAccessLeg: No exact container-pin-to-route access leg is added; additional sites are graph-node research anchors.
method.access: All locations are public in this scenario except WH23, which remains restricted to its configured allowlist. WH24-public is a user-supplied scenario assumption.
method.buildability: A13 and A36 are not reassessed or approved build pins; every additional anchor still needs municipal-land, utilities, safety and HVC checks.
